summary: The fix works. Bots now use action ranges, and the all-TAG WTSD drops from 94.2 to about 41 at the same seeds. A turn call counts the river big bet, with correct stack and all-in edge cases. A value raise needs more than 65.0%, and grading measures from the threshold that applied. The explanations carry the Q-3 clause in the real app. The 100k all-TAG check puts all five stats inside the 6-max ranges. The full unit, golden, Playwright and slow suites pass, apart from the accepted Mixed failures, and there is no sign of tampering. SPEC-01 fails on one point: the backlog implementation notes do not yet link to the postflop-rules.md investigation section, so this round is FAIL until that note is added.
